review_notes: I read the whole target file and the ProjectiveClass, `of`, `liftFunction` and `lift` definitions in K0.lean. I grepped Mathlib for existing semiring or isomorphism-class constructions on projective modules and found none that this file duplicates. The one possible overlap is `tensorMul`, which `instCommSemiring` later turns into `*`, so `mul_eq_tensorMul` holds by `rfl`. I did not report it. It is the staging definition the semiring structure is built from, and `Mul` needs a function to be defined from. The tensor multiplication is built over Mathlib's `TensorProduct` equivalences, so it does not introduce a competing tensor-product concept. I also did not report the private abbrevs `directSumAddCommMonoid`, `k0AddCommGroup` and `completionMap`. They only pin instances and are not alternative versions of a Mathlib concept. The one remaining uncertainty is that I did not check whether the monoidal-skeleton machinery could replace `tensorMul` as a refactor. That would be a proof-structure change, not a duplicate concept.
